correctness.rationale: Circular Dirichlet spacing representation gives exact exponential coupling; event A is equivalent to a Gamma(2,1) sum exceeding n-2 independent exponentials. Beta differentiation yields \(H_{n-1}/(n-1)\); memoryless exponential shifts yield the entire finite increase-tail polynomial. Conditioned joint density of the competing maximum and overshoot converges pointwise to the normalized product \(e^{-2x-e^{-x}}e^{-w}\); Scheffe gives total-variation convergence. The possibility that an original constituent gap dominates is at most \(2/H_{n-1}\). Chernoff concentration, valid even after conditioning on a probability \(\asymp\log n/n\) event, removes normalization error. The marked Uniform split is exactly independent of the Gamma sum. Replayed script produced 83 deterministic finite/numerical assertions; these do not replace the analytic limit proof.

value.rationale: Loss of one uniformly selected site is the natural leave-one-out failure mechanism for circular coverage or hash-ring load. Exact finite risk \(H_{n-1}/(n-1)\) is distinct from the unconditioned worst-hole mean; the sharp rare-event three-mark law resolves the severity, conditional baseline and failed-site location. This is a motivated joint extreme-value boundary phenomenon, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine renaming of the all-window 2-spacing law.
